Responsibilities Operational Excellence: Oversee, streamline, and optimize the performance of gasification and power production units to maximize plant availability, reliability, and efficiency. EHSS Leadership: Cultivate a safety-first culture, ensuring strict compliance with Environmental, Health, Safety, and Security (EHSS) standards across all operations. Team Leadership & Development: Build, mentor, and guide a high-performing technical team, fostering capability growth and aligning organizational output with strategic objectives. Production & Commercial Alignment: Direct production planning processes to meet customer and partner supply requirements while honoring contractual agreements. a332f8d3c3e1d77d.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking an AO Performance Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves monitoring, analyzing, and improving mobile Core Network performance. The engineer will combine telecom expertise with analytical and operational skills to detect anomalies, investigate performance issues, and ensure network stability, availability, and service quality. Role Context and Contribution As an Automated Operations Performance Monitoring Core Engineer, you will contribute to maintaining the integrity and efficiency of the Core Network. You will work within a diverse team, focusing on proactive identification and resolution of network performance challenges, and supporting the evolution towards automated operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze Core Network performance across domains and technologies to ensure service availability, stability, and performance. Analyze Core Network KPIs, counters, and trends to identify degradation, abnormal behavior, and potential service-impacting issues. Investigate performance anomalies using historical trends, counter correlation, thresholds, and established baselines. Proactively identify network issues, initiate investigations, coordinate with relevant technical teams, and follow up on corrective actions. Support proactive and reactive performance monitoring activities, including timely escalation and resolution of incidents in line with SLAs. Analyze performance data and operational reports to identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous improvement of automated monitoring, anomaly detection, dashboards, and reporting solutions. Collaborate with Core Network Operations, Performance Management, Optimization, and other technical teams to improve troubleshooting and operational efficiency. Prepare performance reports, technical findings, and operational documentation, clearly communicating risks, issues, and required actions. Contribute to automation initiatives and analytical solutions supporting the transformation toward Automated Operations. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Computer, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum years of telecommunications experience, with exposure to mobile Core Network technologies and operations. Basic knowledge of 4G/LTE and 5G Core architecture, network elements, interfaces, and services. Understanding of Core Network performance monitoring, KPIs, counters, and performance measurements. Experience in performance monitoring, KPI analysis, performance management, or network troubleshooting is an advantage. Knowledge of Core Network elements such as MME, SGW, PGW, AMF, SMF, UPF, and IMS is an advantage. Required Skills Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify abnormal trends, and investigate potential root causes. Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools. Experience with dashboards, data visualization, or analytical tools is an advantage. Basic knowledge of Python, SQL, scripting, data analysis, or automation is a plus. Proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position within Ericsson. a39b354287727dc5.job_title: Senior Energy Efficiency & Retrofit Project Engineer Great Opportunity for Saudi Nationals

a3b560a9a7d45d5d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث المستشفى السعودي الألماني عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية عالية الجودة للمرضى، مع التركيز على التقييم الشامل، وتخطيط الرعاية، وتنفيذ الإجراءات الطبية، وضمان سلامة المرضى. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض، وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقاً لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة الفعالة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان أفضل الممارسات. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي بدقة واحترافية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض لحماية المرضى والموظفين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة وتحديد احتياجات الرعاية التمريضية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية في تقديم الرعاية الصحية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التمريض ضمن فريق طبي متكامل في المستشفى السعودي الألماني بالمدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية متميزة في بيئة ديناميكية وداعمة. معلومات إضافية المسمى الوظيفي: أخصائي تمريض الشركة: المستشفى السعودي الألماني الموقع: المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق المستشفى السعودي الألماني.

a341e4eeef006d4a.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع ضياء الابتسامة لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في حائل. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، وتقديم خطط علاجية شاملة، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع حالة كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. مواكبة التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان وتطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كطبيب أسنان عام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة في ممارسات طب الأسنان. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع ضياء الابتسامة لطب الاسنان بمدينة حائل. يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق متخصص لتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: حائل الراتب: غير معلن

a3927fbe0ece1c1e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ذراع ناف للمقاولات عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم مهندس الأبنية في الإشراف على عمليات الإنشاء، وجمع العينات، وضمان مطابقة المواصفات الفنية للمشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ. جمع عينات من تربة موقع البناء والمواد الإنشائية والخلطات الإسمنتية، وإرسالها إلى المختبر لفحصها. التأكد من مطابقة المواد والعمليات للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. تفقد الأعمال الإنشائية أثناء وبعد التنفيذ لضمان الجودة والمطابقة. المشاركة في قياس الأعمال المنجزة بالتنسيق مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإنشاءات أو ما يتصل بها. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية. القدرة على تقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات، ويدعم المشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

a381a753155a6388.description: About the Role Jari Solutions is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead the organization's cybersecurity function. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is responsible for protecting information assets, systems, and services while ensuring compliance with the Saudi Central Bank Cyber Security Framework (SAMA CSF). The CISO will oversee cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and incident response, aiming to achieve and maintain a minimum targeted cybersecurity maturity level of Level 3. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement cybersecurity strategy, policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Establish and maintain cybersecurity governance frameworks, define roles and responsibilities, and integrate security requirements into business projects and initiatives. Report cybersecurity risks, maturity levels, compliance status, and key performance indicators to senior management, the Cybersecurity Committee, and the Board of Directors. Develop and manage the cybersecurity budget, lead the cybersecurity team, and oversee employee development and awareness programs. Establish and oversee cybersecurity risk management processes, maintain the risk register, conduct risk assessments, and monitor mitigation plans. Assess cybersecurity risks associated with third parties, outsourced services, cloud environments, and significant technology changes. Ensure compliance with SAMA CSF and applicable regulatory requirements, and lead cybersecurity maturity assessments and internal and external audits. Manage corrective action plans, track audit and regulatory findings, and coordinate regulatory reporting with the Compliance Department. Oversee cybersecurity event monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security operations. Approve and lead cybersecurity incident response activities, ensure timely regulatory reporting, and implement lessons learned following incidents. Oversee cybersecurity controls across networks, applications, endpoints, identity management, and cloud services. Organizational Structure and Independence The CISO will maintain organizational independence from the Information Technology Department. This includes independent reporting lines, budget management, and employee performance evaluation, ensuring objective oversight of cybersecurity functions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in information security leadership roles. Demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, and incident response. In-depth knowledge and experience with the Saudi Central Bank Cyber Security Framework (SAMA CSF) and other applicable regulatory requirements. Proven ability to lead and manage cybersecurity teams and initiatives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dedicated cybersecurity function, collaborating with various departments to ensure comprehensive information security across the organization. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

This full-time role involves leading cybersecurity initiatives to protect critical rail systems and project data, ensuring the resilience and security of modern transportation infrastructure. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead cybersecurity planning and implementation efforts to safeguard critical rail systems and project data. Conduct context and risk analyses to identify potential threats and ensure system resilience. Prepare necessary cybersecurity deliverables and review cybersecurity design packages. Define cybersecurity architecture, allocate requirements, and cascade them to suppliers. Manage cybersecurity assurance levels and evaluate achieved security performance. a331d185c1a96c8b.description: About the Role Accor is seeking a Maintenance Engineer / Shift Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing operational maintenance and systems, coordinating with various departments, and ensuring safety and compliance within the hotel environment. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor, inspect, maintain, and repair building services and equipment, including HVAC systems, chillers/cooling towers, boilers, generators, domestic water systems, pumps, lifts, lighting, kitchen equipment, pool & spa systems, and plumbing. Execute planned preventive maintenance (PPM) to ensure efficient, consistent, and safe system operation. Respond promptly to engineering and guest service requests and breakdowns, minimizing downtime and coordinating urgent repairs. Log all activities, complete shift hand-over reports, and maintain maintenance logbooks and checklists. Monitor energy consumption and support the implementation of energy-saving and sustainability initiatives. Coordination and Communication Act as the on-duty engineering representative during the shift, coordinating with departments such as Housekeeping, Front Office, F&B, Security, and Maintenance to support guest operations and resolve issues efficiently. Report major equipment failures, safety hazards, or operational risks to the Senior/Chief Engineer. Assist in training and guiding junior engineers/technicians as needed during the shift. Safety, Compliance, and Standards Ensure all systems and maintenance practices comply with local regulations (fire, health & safety, mechanical/electrical codes) and the hotel’s operational standards. Conduct regular rounds of guest floors, plant rooms, public areas, and back-of-house to verify safe and appropriate conditions. Maintain inventory of spare parts, tools, and equipment, ensuring proper storage and usage. Ensure proper hand-over to the next shift, documenting all outstanding tasks, pending work, and critical issues. Working Conditions This role operates on a shift basis (morning/afternoon/night), including weekends and public holidays, and requires availability for emergency call-outs within the shift. Work involves various areas such as plant rooms, rooftops, service corridors, guest areas, and outdoor equipment areas. Physical activity, climbing ladders, working at heights, and exposure to heat/humidity environments typical of Riyadh may be required. The hotel setting demands awareness of guest presence and maintaining quiet and safe operations for guest comfort. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh.

a3e8dd57472f0923.description: About the Role كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Fabricator III to join its Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) division. This full-time role involves organizing and executing piping fabrication activities to meet plant requirements safely and effectively. Organize necessary resources, including materials and equipment, for pipe fabrication work. Ensure all pipe fabrication activities comply with quality specifications. Execute fabrication tasks both at the site and in the field. Track the progress of ongoing pipe fabrication jobs. Log all progress related to pipe fabrication and report to the pipefitter supervisor. Support investigation efforts for failure analysis of piping circuits. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in fabrication. a31dc5c2955e8065.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مستويات التشغيل للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. التأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة والمواد المستخدمة في هذه النظم. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة مستويات التشغيل للمقاولات المعمارية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور والراتب.

a329ec70238b5853.description: About the Role Panda Retail Company – Savola Group is seeking a Fleet Senior Coordinator/Fleet Compound Admin to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role involves coordinating daily fleet operational activities, monitoring service requests, and ensuring timely resolution of incidents to maintain uninterrupted transportation services. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Fleet Senior Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and supporting the daily operations of the fleet, ensuring vehicles are available and deployed efficiently. This includes managing service requests, addressing breakdowns, and coordinating with various teams to minimize vehicle downtime and ensure compliance with operational and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily fleet operational activities, including vehicle availability and deployment support, to ensure continuous transportation services. Monitor fleet service requests, breakdown reports, and incidents to ensure prompt follow-up and resolution. Liaise with maintenance teams, workshops, and service providers regarding vehicle servicing and repair status to reduce downtime. Track fleet utilization, availability, and operational issues to identify gaps and support corrective actions. Prepare fleet operational logs, summaries, and performance trackers to ensure accurate reporting and visibility. Support the implementation of fleet operational plans and schedules in coordination with Fleet Operations and Transportation teams. Guide fleet coordinators and clerks on procedures, reporting requirements, and escalation protocols to ensure consistent execution. Communicate operational updates, constraints, and resolutions to drivers and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and service continuity. Apply fleet operating procedures, safety guidelines, and governance standards during all coordination activities to ensure compliance and audit readiness. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in fleet coordination or a related administrative role. Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex operational activities. Experience in monitoring service requests and managing incident resolution. Proficiency in preparing operational logs and performance reports. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, offering an opportunity to contribute to the efficient operation of a key retail company's transportation services. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role.

a36a39c66b06fc3f.description: About ARIS ARIS is a Process Intelligence company dedicated to helping organizations discover, create, and transform their processes. The company focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes and scaling AI with confidence. ARIS integrates process design, real execution insight, and AI-driven optimization into a single platform, enabling organizations to build a governed digital twin of their operations. By providing the necessary process foundation, visibility, and governance for AI adoption, ARIS supports businesses in deploying and scaling Agentic AI safely and effectively. This ensures that agents operate on trusted processes, data, and controls. With over 30 years of expertise and recognition from leading analysts such as Gartner and Forrester, ARIS is a trusted partner for global enterprises in converting process intelligence into tangible business impact. This full-time role involves acting as a core commercial and engagement orchestrator within Professional Services. The Services Account Manager will partner closely with Account Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Success Managers, Delivery Leads, and Partners. The primary responsibility is to own the commercial lifecycle of Professional Services engagements, from shaping engagement models and pricing to managing contracts, margins, forecasting, and identifying expansion opportunities. Key Responsibilities Manage the commercial lifecycle of Professional Services engagements, including scoping, engagement models, pricing, contracting, margins, forecasting, and renewals. Collaborate with Account Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Success Managers, Delivery Leads, and Partners to develop and position Professional Services offerings. Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with strategic customers and stakeholders across APJ and the Middle East regions. Identify and pursue expansion, cross-sell, and additional Professional Services opportunities within existing customer accounts. Ensure pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and clear visibility of Professional Services opportunities and revenue. Align customer demand and commercial commitments with delivery capacity, resources, and timelines. Support the development of value-based proposals and commercial structures that align with customer outcomes. Serve as a trusted commercial advisor to customers, helping them understand the value and impact of ARIS Professional Services. Work with internal teams to resolve commercial, contractual, and delivery-related issues. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, or commercial roles within enterprise software or consulting. Demonstrated experience managing the commercial lifecycle of enterprise Professional Services engagements. Proven ability to work with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Strong commercial acumen, including experience with pricing, contracts, margins, forecasting, and pipeline management. Ability to identify and develop expansion and cross-sell opportunities within existing customer relationships. Solid understanding of Professional Services delivery models, resource planning, and customer engagement structures. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across sales, delivery, product, and executive teams. Work Authorization Applicants must have the legal right to work in Saudi Arabia without requiring employer sponsorship. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

a3b1f378c752c8c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال ذي الصلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها لضمان الأداء الأمثل. تقديم المساعدة والدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية المعقدة. تحديد المخططات التفصيلية، وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في أعمال تركيب الأنظمة الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها للتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال المحتملة والتلف، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات التالفة، وتشخيص المكونات المعطوبة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ لتقليل فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي والحفاظ على استمرارية العمليات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو ما يعادلها. فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الهندسية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير الفنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة سراكو، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

a3bfd93bfdd89d6b.description: About the Role Elegancia Arabia is seeking a Senior Estimation and Tendering Manager to lead the preparation, evaluation, and submission of competitive bids for large-scale, mega, and giga projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves managing the complete tendering lifecycle, from initial opportunity assessment and cost estimation through commercial review, bid submission, clarification, negotiation, and handover to the project delivery team. Key Responsibilities Lead the complete tendering process, including bid/no-bid assessments and developing tender strategies. Coordinate technical and commercial inputs from various internal teams to ensure comprehensive submissions. Manage tender clarifications, presentations, post-tender negotiations, and best-and-final-offer submissions. Lead the preparation of detailed cost estimates, including materials, labour, equipment, and subcontracting. Conduct comprehensive commercial, contractual, and technical risk assessments for each tender. Coordinate with procurement teams to obtain competitive quotations and evaluate them for compliance. Utilize Candy CCS as the mandatory estimating and cost-planning platform and SAP for relevant processes. Lead, mentor, and develop estimation and tendering team members. Lead the formal handover of awarded projects to the operations and project teams, communicating scope, budget, and contractual commitments. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 12–15 years of progressive experience in estimation, bidding, and tendering. Strong experience bidding for large-scale, mega, or giga projects in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrable record of preparing and securing successful bids. Previous experience within major construction, interior contracting, or high-end fit-out organizations. Candidates currently based in Saudi Arabia are preferred. Experience working with large FITOUT organizations is highly desirable. Mandatory Technical Requirements Advanced hands-on proficiency in Candy CCS is mandatory. Strong working knowledge of SAP is required. Advanced knowledge of cost estimation, quantity take-offs, resource-based pricing, and cost planning. Strong understanding of construction and fit-out methodologies, materials, specifications, and productivity rates. Knowledge of the Saudi construction market, including local suppliers, subcontractors, labour rates, and regulatory requirements. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and tender-reporting tools. Sound understanding of commercial terms, contracts, cash-flow forecasting, and tender risk management. Team Leadership and Development The Senior Estimation and Tendering Manager will lead, mentor, and develop a team of estimators, quantity surveyors, tender engineers, and bid coordinators. This includes allocating responsibilities, monitoring performance against deadlines, and establishing standardized estimating procedures and tender governance processes. The role promotes accuracy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the department. Application Process This full-time position offers an opportunity to contribute to significant projects within Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a390ab17fb4a9154.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة درجة مئوية الطبية عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تلبية احتياجات الشركة من المواد والسلع بكفاءة، من خلال عمليات الشراء المباشر والمناقصات، مع ضمان الجودة وتقليل التكاليف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد احتياجات الشركة من المواد والسلع المختلفة. البحث عن الموردين المحتملين وتقييمهم. التفاوض على الأسعار والشروط وإعداد العروض الخاصة بالمشتريات. إصدار أوامر الشراء ومتابعة تنفيذها. متابعة استلام المشتريات والتأكد من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المدونة في أمر الشراء، بالتعاون مع قسم المخازن. ضمان جودة المشتريات وتقليل التكاليف من خلال العروض التنافسية والتفاوض الفعال. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات والتنسيق مع القسم المالي لتسديد فواتير الموردين في مواعيدها. التعاون مع قسم المخازن لضمان توفر المواد المطلوبة وإصدار سندات الإدخال. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتقارير تكاليف المشتريات بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحديد احتياجات الشركة والبحث عن الموردين. مهارات تفاوض ممتازة وقدرة على إعداد العروض. القدرة على متابعة الشحنات والطلبات وضمان الجودة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وتحليل التكاليف. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع الأقسام الداخلية مثل المخازن والمالية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على وظيفة مندوب مشتريات، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

a3faf93e1062f156.description: The person will be a Specialist in Control system for the large utility scale IBR based power plants (> 1 GW) such as Solar, Wind, BESS, Hybrid Power plants, Large Micro grids feeding to hydrogen process plants as well as connected to EHV Grid. Also, expertise in developing control systems for Large Islanded Micro grid.His in-depth domain expertise in Control System is required to provide technical leadership encompassing Conceptual engineering, Basic Engineering, Detailed Engineering, Factory acceptance testing, Site acceptance testing & commissioning to ensure seamless operation of plant in line with grid code requirements. The expert candidate shall have overall experience in the field of control system for 15 years and in technical leadership level for 5 more years. Key Responsibilities 1) Conceptualization and Engineering The candidate shall have a thorough understanding of IBR plant operations requirements such Normal, Contingency & Emergency scenarios. Further candidate needs to have hands-on experience in developing the required Control system Architecture for operation of above-mentioned types of IBR based Power plants as required. This is needed during the Basic and Detailed engineering stage. The Control system architecture developed needs to ensure proper compliance with Grid code by taking into the account of various power elements functional characteristics, such as Inverter, STATCOM, WTG, BESS etc as applicable. Thorough hands-on experience in developing a detailed functional specification for various controllers from a simple PV plant controller to complex hybrid controller as per the requirement of project. The candidate shall have extensive experience in handling the AGC in controlling the power system control and needs to apply it suitably while developing the control system for project specific requirements. Shall be able to develop/review the Control Architecture required to meet the plant operations within the grid code guidelines. Shall have a thorough understanding of the different communication protocols like Modbus TCP/IP / IEC 104 / IEC 61850 Goose etc and pros and cons of the different protocols. Shall have hand-on experience in Design / Setup & tuning the parameters of control system such as gain, time constant, anti-windup, low pass and high pass filters, etc to meet the overall objective of the system operation, while meeting the design requirements of various power elements. Expertise is required to have understanding on power system study such as Static/Dynamic and Transient to review Grid compliance as well as Grid impact studies. He shall be able to develop the model of the controller in PSS/e, Dig SILENT, PSCAD etc, and able to review the power system study reports to interpret the parameters required for control system tuning. Shall be well versed in Set-up & Testing through RTDS system (HIL system) to test various control parameters to validate the required performance of overall control system. Hands on experience in applying GPS / GNSS based Time synchronization, and familiar with IEEE 1588 (PTP), IEEE C37.238 protocols. Thorough knowledge and experience required in interfacing Advanced Numerical Meters & Measuring Devices including configuration and handling the systems Class-A power quality measurements (voltage events, RVC, flicker, harmonics/inter-harmonics) per IEC 61000-4-30 (ed.4: 2025); ensure correct aggregation windows and reproducibility. PMU/synchro phasor measurements per IEEE C37.118 (phasor TVE, frequency, ROCOF, time tag quality) and integrate with PDC/SCADA. Shall have hands-on experience in interpreting the Grid code requirements and be able to adapt it suitably while developing specifications for Controllers. Requires in-depth knowledge in relevant international IEC / IEEE standards as well as usage of CIGRE / other scientific technical journal with respect to control system design requirements. Shall have thorough knowledge in implementing Cyber security as per relevant international standards. Sound experience in assessment of risk and provide mitigation plan based on validation of hybrid controller / PPC logic etc., Power system Studies results against Grid code Steady state and Dynamic State requirements before taking up the field commissioning. 2) Testing & Commissioning and Trouble shooting The candidate shall have thorough hands-on experience in Cold and HOT commissioning of Control systems in IBR plants by tuning the control parameters at field. He shall have experience in trouble shooting the performance of the Controllers and associated system elements, and able to understand and recreate the scenarios through RTDS system for the operational issues encountered during commissioning as well as during operation as part of the root cause analysis (RCA) and tune the control system parameters. Desired Candidate Profile B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical & Electronics M. Tech in Control systems. Ph.D in Control System

a3e273a17eb98765.description: Position Objective The Area Visual Merchandiser (VM) is responsible for leading the visual merchandising strategy across a large area/region/country of stores, ensuring that the visual presentation aligns with the brand identity and enhances the overall shopping experience. a35b17d2f5f4ce3d.description: CX Sales Executive – Hunter الهدف الوظيفي: استقطاب عملاء جدد وتنمية المبيعات من خلال تسويق وبيع منتجات وخدمات تجربة العملاء (CX)، مع التركيز على تطوير أعمال جديدة، فتح حسابات جديدة، وبناء فرص بيعية ذات جودة وتحويلها إلى صفقات ناجحة. المهام الرئيسية: استكشاف واستهداف عملاء وفرص أعمال جديدة في السوق السعودي. بناء وتطوير قاعدة عملاء محتملين والتواصل مع صناع القرار بشكل مباشر. تسويق وبيع حلول تجربة العملاء (CX) ومراكز الاتصال (Contact Center) والخدمات المرتبطة بها. توليد الفرص البيعية وتطويرها من مرحلة الاستكشاف وحتى إغلاق الصفقة. فهم متطلبات العملاء وتقديم الحلول المناسبة بالتنسيق مع الفرق الفنية وPre-Sales. إعداد ومتابعة العروض التجارية والتفاوض على الفرص حتى الإغلاق. بناء وإدارة Pipeline بيعي قوي يضمن تحقيق المستهدفات الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية. توثيق ومتابعة العملاء والفرص والأنشطة من خلال نظام CRM. المؤهلات والخبرات: خبرة في مبيعات الحلول التقنية B2B، ويفضل في CX أو Contact Center أو ICT. سجل مثبت في استقطاب عملاء جدد وفتح حسابات وتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية. معرفة جيدة بالسوق السعودي وقطاعات الأعمال والجهات المستهدفة. مهارات عالية في التواصل، التفاوض، بناء العلاقات وإغلاق الصفقات. شخصية مبادرة وموجهة نحو النتائج، مع توجه واضح نحو New Business / Hunter Sales.

a3bafb6830741131.description: About EPSA EPSA is a global family-owned business with over 60 years of experience in the mining, civil, and earth-moving industries, operating across multiple countries. a3c2126b9ef43331.description: Job Title: Corporate Communications Manager Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Function: Corporate Communications Position Type: Permanent, full-time (Relocation supported) About the Opportunity We are constructing one of the largest primary metals and industrial complexes in the Middle East—a multi-billion-dollar project backed by international industrial shareholders and a major sovereign investment ecosystem. Having spent the development phase out of view, we are now transitioning from confidentiality to high international visibility. As there is currently no existing communications function, website, owned channels, or brand system, this appointment represents a ground-floor "build mandate". Everything the organisation communicates publicly over the next decade will begin with this role. The Role You will establish the organisation as a credible, disciplined, and internationally legible industrial enterprise. You will own the strategy and execution of our emergence from confidentiality, the overarching corporate narrative, and the governance standards required for an asset backed by listed shareholders across multiple jurisdictions. a38d63a9f0123bcd.description: Eram Talent is partnering with a prestigious, industry-leading Oil & Gas organization in Saudi Arabia to identify a highly technical Senior ASU Commissioning & Start-up Engineer. Commissioning & Start-Up: Provide hands-on leadership during cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-ups, and performance guarantee testing. Troubleshooting & Optimization: Act as the ultimate technical authority for troubleshooting complex operational issues and optimizing Molecular Sieve Adsorption Systems (pre-purification units) for maximum moisture removal and regeneration cycle efficiency. Advanced Process Simulation: Utilize advanced proficiency in Aspen HYSYS or PRO/II, specifically calibrating process simulations for cryogenic air separation cycles and validating models against real-world plant data. Safety & Compliance: Apply deep practical knowledge of Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Fluids Codes. Proven track record in cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-up, and performance testing. Mastery of process simulation software (Aspen HYSYS, PRO/II) with a focus on cryogenic calibration. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional leadership skills.
